cmd.help: Help: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD open, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD info, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD status, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD help. Travel: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD gatelist, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD dial <target> [source], /PH_PLUGIN_CMD warp <target gate>. Admin only: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD registerGate, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD unregisterGate <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD trust [UID]. Admin test: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD pack, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD unpack, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD recover.
